user.title: Origin Energy session
user.description: Paste the value of the `auth0` cookie from id.originenergy.com.au (see the README). It starts with `s%3A`.

reauth_confirm.title: Session expired
reauth_confirm.description: Paste a fresh `auth0` cookie value from id.originenergy.com.au.

error.invalid_cookie: That session cookie was rejected. It is usually truncated, or you copied auth0_compat instead of auth0.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Origin (bot protection, network or server error). Wait a few minutes and retry.
error.no_service: No electricity service was found on this account.
error.wrong_account: That cookie belongs to a different account or agreement.
error.auth_not_configured: The Auth0 values in const.py have not been filled in yet (see the README).
